description: Ministry of Justice - Order to appoint 15.08.2015 to be the date on which the Provisions of Parts I, II, III, IV, and IX of the Assistance to and Protection of Victims of Crime and Witnesses Act, No. 4 of 2015 Shell Come into Operation
reasoning: This gazette content announces the commencement date for specific parts of a law (the Assistance to and Protection of Victims of Crime and Witnesses Act, No. 4 of 2015). It is a legal notice issued by the Minister of Justice to bring statutory provisions into operation, which falls squarely under the Legal/Regulatory classification for new laws, acts, and regulations.
